notes.title: Devlog #1 – Welcome to the World of Beastkeepers
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! We’re excited to finally share more details about [b]Beastkeepers[/b], our upcoming idle game where you raise and train magical creatures while building your own evolving world.[/p][p][/p][p]At its heart, Beastkeepers is about [b]progression and discovery[/b]. Every creature you collect can be leveled up, evolved, and assigned roles to generate resources automatically—even while you’re away.[/p][p][/p][p]🔹 [b]Feature Spotlight – Land Customization[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b] You’ll be able to expand and decorate your land, making each playthrough feel personal and rewarding. From mystical forests to enchanted ruins, your territory will grow alongside your beasts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595612/15c9d29b24d515111e883efe60f815e1daf05fde.png"][/img][/p][p]We want Beastkeepers to be a cozy yet strategic experience—something you can enjoy casually but still feel proud of your progress.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 [b]Wishlist Beastkeepers on [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652940/Beastkeepers/"]Steam[/url][b] today and join our [/b][url="https://discord.gg/DbtDSuxkHx"]Discord[/url][b] to follow the journey![/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Announcement Trailer and Demo Release!
notes.content:
We are so proud to announce the demo of our new game: Beastkeepers!

[previewyoutube=Ypl8sgHkhBg;full][/previewyoutube]

Beastkeepers is your creature taming adventure at the bottom of the screen. Breed and train powerful creatures, battle enemies, and earn coins. Use them to unlock new creatures, upgrades, and decorations. Grow stronger and progress endlessly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595612/15c9d29b24d515111e883efe60f815e1daf05fde.png[/img]

This demo is a sneak peak of Beastkeepers, to show you how gameplay works, main mechanic and art of our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595612/4df419f985a9e105b2e6d547edf8bda145d0e81e.png[/img]

Play the demo and add the game to your wishlist to support the development of the game!

Family Devs.
